_about: BF6 (2026-10-21): the bucket (no stats fit under 2A+H+S <= N and A·H+S·|S| <= (N/3)²) and each skill taken off in turn

cards.name: Dolphin Knight
cards.flavor: Rides the moat like open water. Lance first, questions never.

cards.name: Bee Drone
cards.flavor: Struck once, and a swarmling boils out immediately to keep the line held.

cards.name: Caustic Scorpion
cards.flavor: Wooden tank tread bolted to a scorpion’s tail. The sting lingers long after the tread stops.

cards.name: Bramblewood Macaque
cards.flavor: Steals rations, steals weapons, occasionally wins the fight anyway.

cards.name: Silverback Brawler
cards.flavor: Doesn’t so much fight a line as flatten the whole thing at once.

cards.name: Webspire Sentinel
cards.flavor: A watchtower spun from silver silk. Nothing crosses its threads unnoticed — or alone.

cards.name: Carrion Fly Swarm
cards.flavor: Small, numerous, and deeply unpleasant to be surrounded by.

cards.name: Stormcaller
cards.flavor: Calls down exactly one bolt the moment it wakes. It is never a wasted one.

cards.name: Reef Shark
cards.flavor: Circles the battlefield once, then bites through however much line is in the way.

cards.name: Beetle Battering-Ram
cards.flavor: A shell like a shield wall, lowered and driven straight through the middle of one.

cards.name: Raven Scout
cards.flavor: Circles once, marks a target, and dives before anyone finishes reading the omen.

cards.name: Boar Rampager
cards.flavor: Does not so much choose a target as choose a direction.

cards.name: Octopus Tactician
cards.flavor: Eight arms, eight opinions on how this fight should go. Usually gets its way.

cards.name: Alpha Howler
cards.flavor: One howl and the whole tree line answers. It rarely fights alone, and it rarely needs to.

cards.name: Grizzly Vanguard
cards.flavor: One swipe was always going to hit more than one target. Nobody told the line to stand so close together.

cards.name: Firetail Trickster
cards.flavor: Nine tales, one of them true, and a tail that's genuinely on fire. Ask it which is which.

cards.name: Fox Warchief
cards.flavor: Never fights the fight in front of it — always the two or three fights just past that one.

cards.name: Grass Viper
cards.flavor: You won't see it in the grass. You'll just start feeling it a moment later.

cards.name: Adder Ambusher
cards.flavor: Coiled and patient right up until it very much isn't.

cards.name: Constrictor Coil
cards.flavor: Doesn't so much attack a line as wrap around the whole thing at once.

cards.name: Venomlord Serpent
cards.flavor: Immune to its own venom, which is the only mercy anyone's ever found in it.

cards.name: Cave Flitter
cards.flavor: Impossible to hit in a straight line, mostly because it refuses to fly in one.

cards.name: Poison Dart Croaker
cards.flavor: Small, brilliantly colored, and a genuinely terrible idea to touch.

cards.name: Bog Behemoth
cards.flavor: Older than the castle, wider than the moat, and in absolutely no hurry to leave the mud.

cards.name: Sand Widow
cards.flavor: Weaves its web between two dunes and waits exactly as long as the desert does.

cards.name: Orca Vanguard
cards.flavor: Hunts in a pack that never needs to be told the plan twice.

cards.name: Quill Volley
cards.flavor: Doesn't wait to be grabbed. Fires first and rolls into a ball to think it over later.

cards.name: Stone Turtle Warden
cards.flavor: Nothing wrong with a slow answer, so long as it's the same answer every time: no.

cards.name: Quill-Thorn Boar
cards.flavor: It never learned to dodge. It never had to.

cards.name: Hawk Arrowkeeper
cards.flavor: Two arrows, always. One for the target, one for anyone thinking of helping.

cards.name: Jaguar Stalker
cards.flavor: The canopy does not rustle. Then it is already too late.

cards.name: Toucan Courier
cards.flavor: Trades gossip and acorns at a very favorable exchange rate.

cards.name: Poison Dart Frog
cards.flavor: Small, bright, and a genuinely terrible idea to lick.

cards.name: Savanna Cheetah
cards.flavor: Already at the bramble by the time the wait timer means anything.

cards.name: Termite Mound
cards.flavor: Looks like scenery. Fights like a fortress.

cards.name: Clownfish Scout
cards.flavor: Small, orange, and somehow always exactly where the hit was headed.

cards.name: Coral Reef Shark
cards.flavor: Circles once out of professional courtesy. Then does not.

cards.name: Sea Turtle Elder
cards.flavor: Has outlived several reefs. Intends to outlive this fight too.

cards.name: Golden Eagle Diver
cards.flavor: Stoops from a height that makes the math feel unfair.

cards.name: Rockslide Ram
cards.flavor: Charges downhill. Somehow charges harder every time.

cards.name: Cave Bat Swarm
cards.flavor: One bat is a nuisance. This is never just one bat.

cards.name: Obsidian Scorpion
cards.flavor: Glass-edged and doubly unkind about it.

cards.name: Boreal Elk
cards.flavor: Antlers wide enough to clear a path through anything in the lane.

cards.name: Tide Pool Crab
cards.flavor: Small, sideways, and surprisingly hard to actually pinch out of a fight.

cards.name: Barnacle Fortress
cards.flavor: Technically alive. Technically a wall. Extremely thorough about the second part.

cards.name: Mangrove Mudskipper
cards.flavor: Neither fully a land animal nor a water one. Fully unbothered by the distinction.

cards.name: Gangrenous Leech
cards.flavor: Fester: the longer its own poison sits in its veins, the harder the next bite lands.

cards.name: Ravenous Wolverine
cards.flavor: Bloodlust 2: it does not slow down once it starts swinging. It speeds up.

cards.name: Humpback Elder
cards.flavor: Old enough to remember when this reef was someone else's territory.

cards.name: Dune Jackal
cards.flavor: Crosses open sand faster than the heat has time to punish it for.

cards.name: Sandstorm Roc
cards.flavor: Arrives as weather. Leaves as a body count.

cards.name: Porcupine Roller
cards.flavor: Curls into a ball. The ball has opinions about being kicked.

cards.name: Quillback Elder
cards.flavor: Decades of bad decisions, made by other people, against this exact hide.

cards.name: Chipmunk Cavalry
cards.flavor: Small, fast, and inexplicably first into every fight anyway.

cards.name: Slowpoke Sentinel
cards.flavor: Has not moved in three rounds. Has also not taken meaningful damage in three rounds.

cards.name: Duckling Squadron
cards.flavor: In a row. Always in a row. Somehow that is the scary part.

cards.name: Tomcat
cards.flavor: Territorial, uninvited, and somehow already attacking before the round starts.

cards.name: Rootworm Colony
cards.flavor: Quietly ruins the soil, the roots, and eventually your whole strategy.

cards.name: Jackrabbit Sprinter
cards.flavor: Across the field and back before the wait timer even means anything.

cards.name: Barrow Leech
cards.flavor: Drinks first. Asks questions never.

cards.name: Coral Current Eel
cards.flavor: A small bite. A slow, patient problem.

cards.name: Dune Jackal Scout
cards.flavor: Doesn't outrun the sun. Just outlasts it.

cards.name: Nightshade Moth
cards.flavor: The powder from its wings doesn't sting. It just asks, very persuasively, that you lie down.

cards.name: Elder Tortoise
cards.flavor: Its shell has outlasted three generations of otters who swore they'd finally crack it.

cards.name: Plague Gnat Cloud
cards.flavor: One bite is nothing. The cloud makes sure there is never just one.

cards.name: Rivergate Drummer
cards.flavor: One beat for every otter that wades in. The river has never been this loud.

cards.name: Worker Ant
cards.flavor: Carries, digs, hauls. Never once complains.

cards.name: Cobalt Fledgling
cards.flavor: Not cleared for border patrol yet. Practices anyway.

cards.name: Crimson Recruit
cards.flavor: Feather-red is earned, not born. This one's still earning it.

cards.name: Violet Vane Fletcher
cards.flavor: Trims feathers for flight, not for fashion — mostly.

cards.name: Quarry Mole
cards.flavor: Waits on a resource nobody can spend yet. When Stone finally counts for something, this one will already know how.

cards.name: Sparrow Chick
cards.flavor: Hungry, loud, and surprisingly brave.

cards.name: Guppy
cards.flavor: Bright, tiny, and absolutely sure it is a shark.

cards.name: Tiny Cave Dweller
cards.flavor: Clutches a chipped little shell of gold. Will not explain where it got it.

cards.name: Courier Pigeon
cards.flavor: Brings a letter. Sometimes it even brings the right one.

cards.name: Blackmass Acolyte
cards.flavor: Every step it takes leaves the ground a little less holy.

cards.name: Puppeteer Imp
cards.flavor: It never fights. It just finds someone on the other side who will.

cards.name: Fleetfoot'd
cards.flavor: Already halfway down the riverbank before anyone said go.

cards.name: Abbey Goose
cards.flavor: Tends the infirmary. Hisses at the patients anyway.

cards.name: Friar Badger
cards.flavor: Never misses a meal, and never once missed a prayer.

cards.name: Vigil Owl
cards.flavor: Watches over the fallen, and remembers who felled them.

cards.name: Ironmaw Warwolf
cards.flavor: Twice the height of a cart, with blades bolted to its flanks and brow and steel on every claw and tooth. The monkey on its back, Kip, does t

cards.name: Nectar Vintner
cards.flavor: Ferments the morning's blossoms into something the whole roost regrets by evening.

cards.name: Dawn Bellringer
cards.flavor: A hummingbird with a bell three times its size and no sense of the hour.

cards.name: Teatime Toad
cards.flavor: Never in a hurry. There is always time for one more cup.

cards.name: Snail Mail
cards.flavor: Your letters arrive. Eventually. All at once.

cards.name: Wrong-Way Salmon
cards.flavor: Swims downstream on purpose. Nobody ever sees it coming.

cards.name: Inside-Out Hedgehog
cards.flavor: Soft on the outside, prickly on the inside, which is somehow worse.

cards.name: The Old Shell
cards.flavor: It came up the beach before the castle was built.

cards.name: Marshal of Rivergate
cards.flavor: Twenty winters on the river wall. The wall is newer than she is.

cards.name: Daily Post
cards.flavor: Rain, wind or war: the mail gets through by noon.

cards.name: Nectar Sipper
cards.flavor: Never more than a wingbeat from the next flower.

cards.name: Ruby-Throat Duelist
cards.flavor: Strikes first, bows second, never apologises.

cards.name: Ferry Toll-Frog
cards.flavor: One acorn to cross. Two if you look at it funny.

cards.name: Ford Kingfisher
cards.flavor: Belongs to neither side, and dives on both.

cards.name: Conch Crawler
cards.flavor: Most of it is shell. The rest of it is opinions about the shell.

cards.name: Malachite Golem
cards.flavor: Green stone, banded like old water. It curls up the moment anything touches it, and it does not uncurl quickly.

cards.name: Moonlit Hare
cards.flavor: It counts the nights by the shape of the moon.

cards.name: Lunar Howler
cards.flavor: At the full moon the whole valley hears it. At the new moon, nobody does.

cards.name: The Contradiction
cards.flavor: A snow bear that came down into the fire and did not melt. Its heart glows red, and so do its fangs.

cards.name: Cinder Skeleton
cards.flavor: Knock it down once and it rattles. Knock it down twice and it finally takes the hint.

cards.name: Obsidian Lich
cards.flavor: It cut its own heart out of black glass, so nothing could ever break it again.

cards.name: Ember Revenant
cards.flavor: Once the mountain's sworn guard. The oath outlived the guard.

cards.name: Stonedrop Vulture
cards.flavor: Egyptian vultures crack eggs by dropping stones on them. This one has moved on to bigger eggs.

cards.name: Newt Doctor
cards.flavor: Grows back its own tail, so it has no patience for your complaints about a scratch.

cards.name: Vampire Squid
cards.flavor: It folds its cloak over its head and waits. The river mouth has learned to wait too.

cards.name: Goliath Tentacle
cards.flavor: One arm of eight. The boat it came up under is still somewhere above it.

cards.name: Cave Centipede
cards.flavor: A hundred legs, and every one of them is already moving toward you.

cards.name: Thorny Devil
cards.flavor: Every inch of it says no.

cards.name: Fennec Fox
cards.flavor: Hears your plan before you finish thinking it.

cards.name: Meerkat Sentry
cards.flavor: One stands watch. Twelve more are right behind it.

cards.name: Monitor Rambler
cards.flavor: Low, slow and plated. Kicking it is a lesson.

cards.name: Clover Butterfly
cards.flavor: Only comes out when the sun does. So does everyone, really, but she makes a fuss of it.

cards.name: Meerkat Burrower
cards.flavor: Digs the tunnel, then digs another tunnel in case the first one gets ideas.

cards.name: Lion's Mane Jelly
cards.flavor: Its tail is longer than a ferry. Nobody has ever found the end of it on purpose.

cards.name: Caiman Hatchling
cards.flavor: Small, fast and absolutely certain it is the biggest thing in the swamp.

cards.name: Mudpuppy
cards.flavor: Feathery gills, a permanent smile, and mud everywhere.

cards.name: Ember Centipede
cards.flavor: Its legs glow orange from walking on warm stone. It has never once been cold.

cards.name: Cinder Gecko
cards.flavor: Sticks to any wall, even the hot ones. Especially the hot ones.

cards.name: Cave Olm
cards.flavor: Has lived in the dark so long it forgot it had eyes. It does not miss them.

cards.name: Glimmer Spider
cards.flavor: Spins its web out of the shiny bits. Things that like shiny things come to look.

cards.name: Rabid Jackal
cards.flavor: Foam at the mouth, fear of the river. Keep it away from both.

cards.name: Rafflesia
cards.flavor: The biggest flower in the forest, and it smells like a week-old carcass. Whatever stands across from it slowly loses the will to fight.

cards.name: Arc Bat
cards.flavor: Hangs from the iron veins deep underground and drinks the lightning that runs through them.

cards.name: Hammerhead Shark
cards.flavor: Swings that wide flat head through the shoal like a mallet, and senses who is hiding in the sand.

cards.name: Blister Beetle
cards.flavor: Eat it and regret it. The birds that try it once never try it twice.

cards.name: Moon Jerboa
cards.flavor: On the full moon it hops higher than the dunes, and lands a little bigger.

cards.name: Vampire Bat Nurse
cards.flavor: Strange how gently it tends the ones that bleed.

cards.name: Swift Fox
cards.flavor: It was named before anyone saw the other foxes.

cards.name: Pangolin Roller
cards.flavor: Scales like a pinecone, and as hard to argue with.

cards.name: Woodpecker Sapper
cards.flavor: Bark, armour, shield: it is all just wood to a woodpecker.

cards.name: Platypus Spur
cards.flavor: Duck bill, otter fur, and a spur nobody warned you about.

cards.name: Cone Snail
cards.flavor: A pretty shell, a slow crawl, and a harpoon full of something that never wears off.

cards.name: Dromedary
cards.flavor: It packed water for a week and patience for a month, and the desert has yet to outlast either.

cards.name: Ashwing Ptarmigan
cards.flavor: White in winter, brown in summer, and grey since the crater started coughing.

cards.name: Caldera Snow Leopard
cards.flavor: It hunts the crater rim in the steam, where nothing can see it coming and nothing can hear it over the vents.

cards.name: Howdah Archers
cards.flavor: Two langurs, one bow each, and a running argument about whose turn it is to duck.

cards.name: Testudo Tortoise
cards.flavor: Shell up, head in, and let the arrows rain. It has been rained on before.

cards.name: Marshal Tuskwell
cards.flavor: Forty sieges, forty wins, and a howdah with a little flag on it for each.

cards.name: Great Gate
cards.flavor: Oak, iron, gold leaf, and a doorbell nobody has ever dared ring.

cards.name: The Magnate Duck
cards.flavor: He owns the keep, the valley and the road you came in on. Every hit he lands, he invoices.

cards.name: Hedgehog Herbalist
cards.flavor: Pockets full of moss, mint and something nobody should eat raw.

cards.name: Sea Cucumber
cards.flavor: Poke it and it throws its insides at you, sticky threads and all. A week later it has grown a new set and is back on the reef, chewing sand.

cards.name: Grovebearer Dragon-Turtle
cards.flavor: There is a whole wood on its back, with a stream, two badger setts and a shrine. Nobody up there has noticed it walking.

cards.name: Sandfish
cards.flavor: It swims through the dunes the way a fish swims through water, and only comes up to bite.

cards.name: River Mink
cards.flavor: Swims like an otter, bites like a stoat, and answers to neither.

cards.name: Pine Marten
cards.flavor: Down the trunk headfirst, and the squirrel never hears it coming.

cards.name: Grass Snake
cards.flavor: Corner it and it rolls over, tongue out, and plays dead. Very convincingly.

cards.name: Hedgerow Shrew
cards.flavor: It must eat every few hours or starve, so it is always, always in a hurry.

cards.name: Slow-worm
cards.flavor: Not a worm, not slow, and not finished just because you grabbed its tail.

cards.name: Pincushion Urchin
cards.flavor: The rock pool's pin cushion. Step on it once and you will always know where it lives.

cards.name: Rock Pool Starfish
cards.flavor: Pull off an arm and it simply grows another. It has five to spare.

cards.name: Limpet Clinger
cards.flavor: When the tide goes out it clamps down. Nothing short of a chisel shifts it.

cards.name: Peregrine Stooper
cards.flavor: The fastest thing alive, falling on purpose.

cards.name: Fulmar Spitter
cards.flavor: Get too close to its nest and it spits stinking oil all over your feathers.

cards.name: Water Shrew
cards.flavor: Silver with bubbles as it dives, and its bite carries venom.

cards.name: Pyrenean Desman
cards.flavor: A trunked, near-blind swimmer that finds its supper by the touch of its whiskers.

cards.name: Diving Bell Spider
cards.flavor: It lives underwater in a bubble of silk and air, and waits there for you.

cards.name: Anhinga Spearbird
cards.flavor: Swims with only its neck above water, then spears whatever swims past.

cards.name: Giant Water Bug
cards.flavor: The toe-biter. It waits on the bottom with its arms wide open.

cards.name: Greater Siren
cards.flavor: When the swamp dries it seals itself in mud and waits, for years if it must.

cards.name: Raft Spider
cards.flavor: Rests its feet on the water and feels for ripples in the dark.

cards.name: Leopard Slug
cards.flavor: Spotted like a big cat, slow as a slug, and very fond of mushrooms.

cards.name: Wolf Spider Mother
cards.flavor: She carries her spiderlings on her back, and still runs you down.

cards.name: Springtail Hopper
cards.flavor: Smaller than a seed, with a spring folded under its belly. Blink and it is gone.

cards.name: Red-backed Salamander
cards.flavor: Breathes through its damp skin and lives under the same log for years.

cards.name: Cave Cricket
cards.flavor: Legs twice as long as its body, and every one of them listening.

cards.name: Cave Pseudoscorpion
cards.flavor: A scorpion with no tail and no sting, just two venom-tipped claws the size of grains.

cards.name: Giant Cave Huntsman
cards.flavor: Wider than your face, faster than your scream, and it has already seen you.

cards.name: Guano Beetle
cards.flavor: Under every bat roost there is a heap, and under every heap, a thousand of these.

cards.name: Banded Sea Krait
cards.flavor: Hunts eels in the roots by night, then crawls ashore to lay its eggs.

cards.name: Fishing Cat
cards.flavor: A cat that loves the water: it taps the surface like a lure, then dives.

cards.name: Horseshoe Crab
cards.flavor: Not a crab at all, but older than the dinosaurs, with blue blood to prove it.

cards.name: Sea Hare
cards.flavor: A sea slug with rabbit ears that hides behind a cloud of purple ink.

cards.name: Yellow-bellied Sea Snake
cards.flavor: It drifts with the slicks in the open ocean and never comes ashore at all.

cards.name: Crown-of-thorns Star
cards.flavor: It eats the reef from the top down, and every one of its spines is venomous.

cards.name: Lionfish
cards.flavor: Its fins spread like a fan of feathers. Every feather is a venomous spine.

cards.name: Giant Clam
cards.flavor: It farms algae in its own lips, and closes like a door.

cards.name: Great Barracuda
cards.flavor: It hangs in the current like a silver blade. Then it is not there any more.

cards.name: Alpine Swift
cards.flavor: It eats, drinks and sleeps on the wing, and may not land for half a year.

cards.name: Alpine Salamander
cards.flavor: Jet black, born live after two years inside its mother, and very hard to impress.

cards.name: Hawthorn Shieldbug
cards.flavor: A green shield with red trim, and a smell that clears the hedge.

cards.name: Garden Tiger Moth
cards.flavor: Its woolly-bear caterpillar is all bristles, and the moth tastes even worse.

cards.name: Polar Bear
cards.flavor: It waits at the breathing hole for hours. The seal only has to come up once.

cards.name: Harp Seal Pup
cards.flavor: A white bundle on the pack ice, drinking the richest milk in the sea.

cards.name: Terraumbra
cards.flavor: Seven slivers of rainbow light circle whoever holds them. Every few rounds they spin faster, and shine a little brighter.

cards.name: Pink Maus
cards.flavor: Round, pink and about the size of a plum. Nothing has ever hurt it, and it has never noticed anyone trying.
